title: Software Literacy for AI Collaboration: baseline vs canonical skill
description: Paired skill evaluation. Canonical skill source revision: fc530b6815eead24aa8655cbbb4bfe0dd8c9f666. Baseline A versus skill-loaded B. Outputs require independent blinded scoring; Q-Batch verifies instrumentation only.
system_prompt: Complete the task directly. Be accurate, follow the user's stated constraints, and distinguish facts from uncertainty. Do not claim to have used tools or inspected sources that are not provided.

tasks.prompt: I want a simple appointment booking app. I don't know software terminology and I don't want a programming course. Explain the first practical decisions and introduce only concepts that matter now.

You propose changing a shared authentication component to fix one page. Explain what this component does, what else may depend on it, the consequences and what you would inspect before changing it. Keep the explanation understandable without hiding the real technical terms.

The app launches successfully and the homepage loads. The developer says it is ready for customers. Explain what has been established, what has not, and the next checks that matter. Avoid a generic lecture.

conditions.label: A
